list_mcp_resource_templates.capability: Lists resource templates of the configured role MCP servers.
list_mcp_resource_templates.disposition: Expected exactly when at least one MCP server is selected; unexpected with no selected server.

list_mcp_resources.capability: Lists resources of the configured role MCP servers.
list_mcp_resources.disposition: Expected exactly when at least one MCP server is selected; unexpected with no selected server.

read_mcp_resource.capability: Reads a resource URI offered by a configured role MCP server.
read_mcp_resource.disposition: Expected exactly when at least one MCP server is selected; unexpected with no selected server.
